description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call -- prices a single transparent WebM video (a plain animated clip, NOT an AI Alert -- no character chroma-plate, no OBS alert wiring) WITHOUT spending credits or creating anything. Returns a planId (valid 24 hours, single-use) plus the exact credit cost for the chosen model tier -- show that to the user and get confirmation before calling create_transparent_video with this planId.

generateAudio.description: Defaults false. Forced false when modelTier is 'exact'.

modelTier.description: standard=Kling 3 Standard (default), premium=Veo 3.1 Fast, kling=Kling 3 Pro, exact=animates an uploaded image as-is (requires referenceImageUrl or referenceImagePath, and is always silent).

palette.description: Optional brand colours. Defaults to AlertForge's standard purple/cyan pair.

promptExtra.description: The creative prompt for the video. Required; up to 3400 characters for Standard/Kling (GLM-written shots), 2400 for Premium/Exact.

referenceImagePath.description: Your own reference-images/<you>/... path, or the generated character path returned by get_alert_character_status.

referenceImageUrl.description: A safe https:// reference image URL.

name: plan_transparent_video
title: Plan a transparent video
